title: Thuyamyint
descriptionAboutMe: I build and operate end-to-end software systems, from frontend and backend to infrastructure and deployment. My focus is on scalable architecture, CI/CD automation, and reliable production systems.
stack: Next.js · Go · Node.js · AWS · CI/CD · Infrastructure · React Native
stackReact: I build web apps with Next.js and mobile apps with React Native, focusing on performance, scalability, and clean architecture using SSR, TanStack Query, and Tailwind CSS.
stackBackend: I design maintainable backend services using Node.js and Go, with clear domain boundaries, stateless APIs, and explicit validation and error handling.
stackData: I work with document and relational databases and Redis, designing schemas and indexes based on access patterns to ensure performance and reliability.
stackInfra: I manage cloud infrastructure with containerization and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring consistent, repeatable deployments across environments.
stackMicroservices: I design microservice architectures with independent services, Docker-based deployment, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging to ensure scalability and fault isolation.
systemArchitectureDescription: The system follows a layered, service-oriented architecture with a Next.js frontend, API gateway, independent backend services, dedicated data stores, and automated cloud deployments via CI/CD.
